Container.Name: Ridepane
Container.Overview: Private passenger media for a Tesla browser. Browse Plex or play a YouTube link, with phone QR pairing and quality settings.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the Ridepane web interface.

Config.Name: App password
Config.Description: A unique password of at least 12 characters. Enter it once on your phone to pair the car.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Plex server address reachable from this container on your LAN.

Config.Name: Plex token
Config.Description: Plex authentication token for browsing your library.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: External HTTPS URL used in the car. Leave blank for LAN-only testing.

Config.Name: Full YouTube browser URL
Config.Description: Optional. Set to http://ridepane-browser:3000 when both containers are on a private Docker network.
